headline: Sales of Leqembi® totaled 29.3 billion yen in the second quarter 2026
summary: BioArctic AB's (publ) (NASDAQ STOCKHOLM: BIOA B) partner Eisai today published the preliminary global revenue for Leqembi for the second quarter 2026, in conjunction with their partner Biogen's second quarter report. In total, sales of JPY 29.3 billion were recorded in the period. This results in a royalty to BioArctic amounting to SEK 179 million, which is an increase of approximately 10 percent compared to the royalty recorded by BioArctic for the second quarter 2025.
